title: Rav Ada son of Rav Yitzchak, or bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yoma 17a; Beitzah 19b; Gittin 28a (resolving Abaye’s difficulty, with Rav Papa challenging him); Zevachim 38a (from which Hyman infers that he lived in Rava’s time); Zevachim 111a; and Menachot 5a.
